parts.hint: Control valve trim: cage (perforated cylinder), plug, stem, seat ring stacked on Y axis.
Hydrodynamic journal (sleeve) bearing: split babbitt-lined shell, two half-cylinders (top/bottom) with oil groove and anti-rotation pin.
Tilting-pad thrust bearing: ring of 6-8 kidney-shaped pads on a carrier ring facing a thrust collar disc.
Labyrinth seal: short sleeve with 6-10 thin circumferential knife-edge teeth (stacked torus/thin cylinders).
Valve positioner: rectangular housing with display window, gauge ports, feedback lever arm.
Flexible disc/grid coupling: two hubs with flanges and a spacer, bolt circle between flanges.
Helical compression spring (TubeGeometry along a helix curve) with ground flat ends.
Seat ring: thick short ring with chamfered sealing edge and threads (torus + cylinder).
Closed centrifugal pump impeller: hub, shroud discs, 6-7 curved backward vanes.
Spiral-wound / ring gasket: flat annulus with inner + outer guide rings.
Steam turbine governor valve: valve chest with plug/cage, actuator linkage and servo cylinder on top.
Turbine/compressor rotor blade: twisted aerofoil (extruded curved profile) with fir-tree root.
Deep-groove ball bearing: outer race torus, inner race torus, 8-12 balls in a cage ring. Axis along X.
Thermocouple assembly: long thin sheath, head (small cylinder) with cable gland.
Cartridge mechanical seal: gland plate (flange with 4 bolt holes), sleeve, rotating face ring + stationary face ring, spring set.
Cylindrical roller bearing: outer/inner rings (tube geometry) with 12-16 short cylinders as rollers, axial along X.
Gate valve: flanged body, bonnet, yoke, handwheel on rising stem, wedge gate inside (gate visible when body in x-ray).
Furnace burner tip: short nozzle cylinder with drilled gas ports around a dome.
Insulating firebrick: rectangular brick (230x114x76 mm) with porous look.
Refractory castable lining: thick curved slab section (furnace wall layer).
Ceramic fiber blanket: soft rolled blanket layer (box with rounded edges).
Globe valve: spherical-ish body with flanges, bonnet, stem, handwheel, plug + seat inside.
Pressure/DP transmitter: twin-chamber housing, round electronics head with display, process flange below.
Shaft sleeve: thin tube with keyway slot and collar.
Safety valve disc: disc with sealing lip and guide stem stub.
Pump wear ring: plain ring with small L-section (casing/impeller wear ring).
Stud bolt: threaded rod with two hex nuts.
Safety valve nozzle: flanged short tube with contoured bore and seat face on top.
O-ring: torus.
Thermowell: tapered closed-end tube with flange at the top.
Motor cooling fan: hub with 8-12 straight radial blades.
Valve stem packing set: stack of 5 square-section rings with spacer/lantern ring.
Wire-mesh demister pad: flat circular slab with mesh texture/grid lines and support grid.
Pipe spool: straight cylinder (tube) with bevelled ends.
Actuator diaphragm: thin flexible disc with a molded convolution (lathe geometry).
Lube oil filter element: pleated cylindrical cartridge (star-shaped cross-section) with end caps.
Solenoid valve: small valve body with coil housing cylinder on top and cable entry.
Needle (instrument) valve: small hex bar-stock body, T-handle, tapered needle stem.
Weld-neck flange: disc with bolt-hole circle and hub.
Limit switch: rectangular body with roller-lever arm.
Column tray valve: round floating cap with 3 bent legs.
Heat exchanger tube plug: tapered pin.
Refractory anchor: V-shaped steel anchor (two bent rods) welded on a plate.
Pressure gauge: round dial face with needle and bottom connection.
Tube fitting connector (male): hex body + threaded end + ferrule nut.
Cable gland: hex body + dome cap with cable hole.
Lube oil: 20 L pail or oil sump level block (translucent amber).
Instrument tubing: thin tube bent with 2 elbows.
Pipe elbow 45/90 deg (torus segment).
Pipe tee: two intersecting cylinders.
Crimp terminal lug: small ring/fork tongue + barrel.
Screw: head + threaded shank.
Grease cartridge/keg: cylinder with lid.
Anchor bolt: rod with L-bend and nut.
Antirust spray can: cylinder with dome and nozzle cap.
LED lamp: bulb on E27 base.
DIN terminal block: thin stacked slices with screw tops on a rail.
Vessel/column inlet screen: perforated cylinder or flat mesh panel.
PTFE/anti-corrosion tape roll: short wide torus/tube.
Cable: bent tube with jacket.

equipment.name: Cracking furnace (BF)
equipment.shells: Refractory-lined firebox box, convection section above, stack on top, side peep doors; walls split for exploded view

equipment.name: Centrifugal compressor / blower (KC)
equipment.shells: Horizontally split casing (top half lifts in explode), suction/discharge nozzles, base skid

equipment.name: Steam turbine driver (KT)
equipment.shells: Split casing with steam chest on top; governor valve rack; exhaust hood

equipment.name: Centrifugal pump + motor (PP)
equipment.shells: Volute casing (front cover explodes forward), bearing housing, motor with fan cover

equipment.name: Shell & tube heat exchanger (HE)
equipment.shells: Shell cylinder (fades in x-ray), channel head + cover explode along axis

equipment.name: Vessel / KO drum (VD)
equipment.shells: Vertical vessel with 2:1 heads, top head explodes up

equipment.name: Distillation column / stripper (CL)
equipment.shells: Tall cylinder, shell sections explode apart vertically to show trays

equipment.name: Control valve (FCV/LCV/PCV/TCV)
equipment.shells: Globe body + bonnet (body fades), diaphragm actuator housing splits upward

equipment.name: On-off / shutdown valve (SDV)
equipment.shells: Ball/gate valve with pneumatic actuator box

equipment.name: Motor-operated gate valve (MOV)
equipment.shells: Gate valve with electric actuator gearbox on top

equipment.name: Pressure safety valve (PRV)
equipment.shells: Angle body + bonnet + cap; bonnet fades to show spring

equipment.name: Transmitter (PIT/FIT/LIT/TIT/DPT)
equipment.shells: Electronics head cover unscrews outward in explode

equipment.name: Temperature element (TEL)
equipment.shells: Head cover lifts; thermowell fades to show sheath

equipment.name: Restriction orifice (ROF)
equipment.shells: Flange pair splits apart to show orifice plate
